methodology.account: An existing subscription account leased by the real manager; identity and credentials omitted
methodology.auth: Run-scoped Unix/vsock broker; manager remains the only refresh-token owner
methodology.mcp: Real authenticated Agent Manager gateway (20 tools) and automatic codex_apps connector (257 tools)
methodology.firstUse: Three distinct guest disks, tools and Codex warmed anonymously before first account binding
methodology.warm: Fresh Codex process for every probe; same VM/home reused; initial first-use sample retained but excluded from steady-state aggregates
methodology.tokenRelay: 275 refresh:false reads during 70 seconds, measured inside the manager container; credential values never emitted
methodology.manager: Three real no-project no-op task executions through the same app-server chat driver; queue/account combined because no manager instrumentation was installed

limits: Prompt accepted means turn/start RPC acknowledged by Codex, not an observed provider HTTP request.
The full manager path uses task queue requests, not a browser chat submission. Browser rendering and phone latency were not measured.
No forced token refresh, account exhaustion or failover was induced.
Small samples and live server/provider load do not establish a tail-latency guarantee.
Per-process features.apps=false is a diagnostic control only; production settings unchanged.

The 4-second relay outlier is retained; a separate 821 ms wait coincided with a quota checkedAt update. Shared-lock code supports contention as the explanation, without isolating every millisecond of the earlier outlier.
